The user asked when to retest, whether a previous TSH result counted, and what signs to watch for before a new test.

output.summary: The user was concerned after the pharmacy dispensed a different maker of their usual levothyroxine and asked what to do. The assistant explained that a new TSH test would be timed for six to eight weeks after the switch, advised keeping the same routine and watching for symptoms, and discussed asking about brand consistency. The user said the plan was clear and exactly the kind of answer they wanted.
